answer: One signal is one fake head. ledge is the only registry slot binding key, endpoint and a live TEE measurement with monotonic counter, so twins collide. ripple is burned to keep that slot valid; it is minted inside the measured host at fixed rate and is non-exportable, while the kth held slot burns k ripple per epoch. Holding n signal needs n distinct hosts and n(n+1)/2 ripple each epoch, not lendable or parallel. It breaks if measurements forge, counters reset, or ripple transfers.
